v: pu॰ apakfzwaH pAWaH । yaTA yasya pAWaH samucitaH tato'nyaTA pAWe apakfzwapAWe “dvAdaSApapAWA asya jAtA iti” si॰ kO॰ ।
m: अप-पाठ m. a mistake in reading, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 64, Sch.
a wrong reading (in a text), VPrāt.
a: अपपाठः — A wrong or bad reading (in a text); mistake in reading; द्वादशापपाठा अस्य जाताः P. IV. 4. 64 Sk.
अपपाद — a. Having bad feet; ˚त्र having no shoe, shoeless.

m: अप-पादत्र mfn. having no protection for the feet, shoeless, Rājat.
अप-पान n. a bad or improper drink.

v: tri॰ apakfzwaM pAtraM BojanapAtraM yasya । caRqAlO tezAM hi Bojane pAtrARAmaprakfzwatvaM tatrAnyErBojanAnarhatvAttezAM taTAtvam “caRqAlaSvapacAnAntu bahirgrAmAn pratiSrayaH apapAtrASca karttavyA iti” manuH ।
m: अप-पात्र mfn. ‘not allowed to use vessels (for food)’, people of low caste, Mn. x, 51; Āp.
a: अपपात्र — a. 1 Deprived of the use of common vessels; using separate vessels (from which no one else will eat); अपपात्राश्च कर्तव्याः Ms. 10. 51. --2 Of low caste.

s: tri, (apakfzwaM pAtraM BojanapAtraM yasya saH, yena janena Bukte BojanapAtramaspazwaM BavatIti yAvat caRqAlAdiH, apapAtraH kftaH, apapAtra + karotyarTe Ric + ktaH .) utkawadozErjYAtiBirBinnodakIkftaH । yaTA, -- apapAtritasya rikTapiRqodakAni nivarttante” । iti SudDitattve SaNKApastambO ।
m: अप-पात्रित mfn. id.
a: अपपात्रितः — [पात्रभोजनात् बाहिष्कृतः] One who has lost his caste through some great sin or offence, and who is, therefore, not allowed by his relatives to eat or drink from a common vessel.

m: अप-पीडा f. a sudden and dangerous attack of illness, Rājat.
अप-पूत m. du. badly formed buttocks, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 187
अप-पूत mfn. having badly formed buttocks, ib.
a: अपपूत — a. Having badly formed hips. --तौ Badly formed hips; P. VI. 2. 187.

m: अपप m. (with Buddhists) a partic. cold hell, Dharmas. 122.
अप-√ पद् to escape, run away.
अप-परे (√ इ), (perf. 1. sg. अप परेतो अस्मि; अप अस्मि may also be taken by itself as fr. 1. अपास्) to go off, RV. x, 83, 5.
अप-पर्य्-आ-√ वृत् to turn (the face) away from, Gobh.
अप-पयस् mfn. waterless, Kir.
अप-√ 1. पृ (aor. Subj. 2. sg. पर्षि) to drive or scare away from (abl.), RV. i, 129, 5.
अप-पित्व n. (probably for -पित्त्व fr. √ 2. पत्; cf. अभि-पित्व, आ-पित्व, प्र-पित्व; but cf. also अपि-त्व s.v. अपि), turning away, separation, RV. iii, 53, 24.
अ-पपिवस् m(gen. अ-पुपुषस्)fn. (perf. p.), who has not drunk, AV. vi, 139, 4.
अप-√ प्लु to spring down, MBh. : Caus. -प्लवयति, to wash off, TS. &c.
अप-प्रदान n. a bribe.
अप-प्र-√ 1. गा (aor. -प्रागत्) to go away from, yield to, RV. i, 113, 16.
अप-प्रजाता f. a female that has had a miscarriage, Suśr.
a: अपप्रजाता — A female that has suffered a miscarriage.

m: अप-प्रसर mfn. checked, restrained, Dharmaś.
अप-प्रे (√ इ), (3. pl. -प्र-यन्ति, or -प्र-यन्ति; Opt. -प्रेयात्) to go away, withdraw, RV. x, 117, 4; ŚBr.
अप-प्रोषित n. (√ 5. वस्), the having departed, a wrong departure or evil caused thereby, (neg. अन्-), ŚBr.
a: अपप्रोषितं — Ved. Fault or evil caused by wrong departure (प्रवासदोष.)

m: अप-√ प्रु अप-प्रवते, Ved. to leap or jump down, ŚBr. &c.
अप-√ प्रुथ् (Imper. 2. sg. -प्रोथ; P. -प्रोथत्) to blow off, RV. vi, 47, 30 and ix, 98, 11.
